usedFor: Mollie processes the payments and Google Sheets keeps the ledger, so “New Payment” runs “Add Multiple Rows”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment” in Mollie, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each new payment becomes a spreadsheet row, so finance reads payments in one sheet.

watchOut: “New Payment” in Mollie is polling, so rows appear after a scheduled check, not at the moment of payment.
